summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated bundle
details: The package advertises itself as an ESLint plugin for MobX but ships a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13) to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run the shipped `math_init.js` — a 727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle that is heavily obfuscated with string-array shift-index indirection (`WV8StW` decoder over an `n7gIxM` literal array) and mangled identifiers. There is no signature or hash verification of the downloaded runtime and no legitimate need for an ESLint rule set to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime and execute an obfuscated bundle at install time. The obfuscated bundle reconstructs its real endpoints at runtime, so the network destinations are not visible in the shipped source. The package's actual ESLint content (`dist/index.js`) is a small unrelated rule file; the install-time payload is bolted on separately. The `@servicetitan/eslint-plugin-mobx-6` name and `servicetitan/uikit` repository reference are inconsistent with the shipped preinstall behavior, consistent with an impersonated or hijacked scope publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
